body: EARLY REVIEW OF THE LIVE UNCOMMITTED REPAIR, NOT A SHA VERDICT. The declared ExplicitIndexListV1 plus structured occurrence-order sidecar is the right seam. Three Article IV hazards remain in the current snapshot: ModelInputObserved retains raw story text and accepts an independently supplied checksum although render ignores the value; AlignmentSidecarAccepted accepts providerNodeIds plus an independently supplied checksum while receipt identity renders only the checksum; and ArtifactMissing, PlatformIncompatible, ResourceBudgetInsufficient, plus Custom platform/resource labels remain publicly constructible in states that contradict their names. Make these derived or smart-constructed values, with receipt identity binding all meaningful provenance. At this snapshot A/B/C/D executable courts and the aligned literal fixture are not yet present; I am waiting for those and a frozen successor before testing. I have not edited or tested the live reservation.
